audit.object: V347 Nor = Hen 2-147 = Wray 16-208 (D-type symbiotic, Mira P = 373 d)

G3_rise.superseded_by: G3_onset_from_cutouts: the Feb 15 plate shows the star; its catalogue limit is a pipeline miss, so this catalogue-only rise is too conservative
G3_rise.same_night_mf: an mf plate the same night measured 10.77 at 12 arcsec offset (saturated; deep plates read bright stars too faint)

G4_luminosity.note: true peak at least this bright; Z And-type outbursts peak at M ~ -2 to -4; RR Tel (1944) ~ -6; classical novae -5 to -9

G5_decline.note: from the first detection; upper limits if the true peak was earlier and brighter

G7_alternatives.mira_maximum: excluded: quiescent B ~ 17-20 (POSS-II J 17.3, SPM4 B 19.8); no maximum brighter than the plate limits in 50 yr of annual cycles before 1943; a Mira cannot rise >= 5 mag in <= 11 d
G7_alternatives.z_and_outburst: disfavoured: amplitude >= 9 mag above quiescent B (B_q ~ 17-19.8; >= 7.4 mag from the first unsaturated plate, day 74) and M_B ~ -6.3 at 3 kpc, vs 2-4 mag and M ~ -2 to -4; absent on Feb 9 (B > 12.9) and Feb 10 (> 11.7), strong on Feb 11 on two cameras: a ~1-day rise vs weeks-months
G7_alternatives.plate_defect_or_asteroid: excluded: 7 plate series, 64 nights over 3 years, stationary
G7_alternatives.dasch_misses: 56 eruption-window plates logged as non-detections show the star in image stamps (docs/figures/rn/v347nor_dasch_misses.png): pipeline misses, not contradictions

G8_nebula.physical_n: 0.25 (momentum, uniform), 0.4 (Sedov, uniform), 0.5 (momentum, r^-2 wind), 0.67 (energy, r^-2 wind)
G8_nebula.note: a 1943 origin needs n = 0.25-0.57, the decelerating-shock regime that Santander-Garcia et al. (2007) independently inferred; a ballistic ring needs an unrecorded outburst ~100-230 yr ago. A third [N II] epoch separates the two (growth rates differ by ~1-3%).

G3_onset_from_cutouts.note: cutout significance S (10 arcsec core vs 100-200 arcsec annulus); the DASCH catalogue logs these plates as non-detections. Feb 11 image strength matches the B = 8.0 plate of Feb 26.
